listing.name: Advanced Flight Computer
listing.abstract: Extra maneuver planning tools for Kitten Space Agency.
listing.description:
Adds quick-tools to the Transfer Planner (set periapsis/apoapsis, match or set inclination, circularize), flyby targeting so a Hohmann transfer arrives as a flyby instead of an impact, multi-pass burn splitting for Oberth-efficient departures, and lets the planner target interstellar comets on hyperbolic orbits.

Features:

- New plan types in the stock Transfer Planner dropdown: Set Periapsis, Set Apoapsis, Match Inclination, Set Inclination.
- Flyby targeting: aim the departure burn at a chosen flyby periapsis and side instead of the target body's center.
- Multi-pass burns: split a departure across successive periapsis passes to reduce finite-burn loss.
